thread:
Sophie: Quick sync — where are we on reserved GPU capacity for EU? Procurement ETA, rack/cable windows, reservation IDs, and any firmware windows we should account for? Need to update the product timeline today.

Kai: PO landed yesterday, vendor confirmed allocation. Ship ETA 2026-04-02, UPS manifest pending. :+1: I'll post tracking when available.

Maria: On networking side we've applied the subnet templates and firewall rules. Cabling and power scheduled Thu (2026-04-08) with datacenter ops. Need one SRE onsite for handoff during burn-in (will require badge access).

Jordan: Reservations created in infra tracker: 
```
resv-eu-2026-04-08-01
resv-eu-2026-04-08-02
resv-eu-2026-04-08-03
```

Ops-bot: inventory update — 3/4 H100 nodes marked "in-transit", none received at DC yet. Last scan: 2026-03-31 14:02 UTC.

Anya: Runtime note — recommend canary on 4-node slice first and fallback to q4_0/q8_0 quantized variants if latency/cost tradeoffs look off. Also we need KV-cache warmup scripts and a prefix-based cache priming step.

Sahil: FYI budget guardrail will auto-block provisioning if projected monthly spend >5% above forecast. If the canary scales beyond 4 nodes we need a short budget signoff from finance.

Kai: Vendor also sent a firmware advisory — mandatory firmware image for NIC/BIOS on arrival. Planning a maintenance window: Wed 2026-04-09 10:00 UTC, estimated 4-6h per rack. I'll add the window to the tracker; expect degraded throughput during updates.

Maria: Assigning canary owners: @Jordan (infra) + @Anya (runtime). Please add a short checklist to the tracker with rollback criteria.

Jordan: Test plan snippet I'll paste into the ticket: 
```
1) Smoke: boot + nvme health checks
2) Perf: run 1000 token gen at 128 seq, measure p50/p95/p99
3) Stability: 6h sustained stream at target qps
4) Rollback: auto-fail to smaller model if p99 > 200ms or error rate > 0.5%
```

Anya: I'll add the warmup script and a perf monitor that posts to the canary channel and fails CI if thresholds breach. PR coming in ~2h.

Sophie: Great — summary/action items: Kai -> post tracking numbers + firmware note; Maria -> confirm SRE onsite and badge; Jordan/Anya -> add canary tests/checklist and warmup scripts; Sahil -> confirm cost signoff if we exceed the 4-node canary. Please update the infra tracker and ping me directly if anything slips. Thanks everyone :rocket:
